blocks.text: Upper Campus
Welcome to our Upper Campus
Excellence in Education Purposeful Discipleship

As a parent, you want your child to have a strong foundation of faith and be prepared for success in college and beyond; to explore their interests and find an encouraging community of friends and mentors.
Westminster’s Upper School provides a high-quality education that equips students with the skills and knowledge they need for success in college, the military, technical careers, and missions.

Our academic program includes AP Courses, fine arts, foreign language, academic support, and mentorship for every student through the Advisory Program. We encourage students to develop their knowledge and skills based on their interests so that their education today is exciting and relevant to their goals after high school.
Every high school student has a mentor through our monthly small-group advisory program, which is crucial to our mission of Christian discipleship.
Exciting Programs & Electives
Classes & College Readiness
Want to learn more about our class offerings? Download our course descriptions for more information.
Growth Outside the Classroom
In addition to required coursework, we offer a variety of electives, clubs, sports, and other co-curricular activities to help students develop their interests and talents.
Athletics

Westminster’s athletics program offers 17 unique sports including football, basketball, swimming, volleyball, softball, golf, tennis, bowling, track and field, cheerleading, dance team, and more. Our highly qualified coaches help student-athletes grow into young men and women for Christ.
Fine Arts
Students participating in our fine arts program learn new skills to last a lifetime. We offer award-winning band and choral programs, theatre, chapel team, and visual arts courses.
Other Activities Include...

blocks.text: Enrichment Opportunities
Whatever their interests, students are encouraged to develop and use their God-given artistic talents for the benefit of their school, church, and community.
Our Graduates

Westminster is more than just a school. It’s a place where everyone works together to help students become servant leaders who understand their identity in Christ, love others, and do their best in every situation. Westminster graduates are…

items: Prepared for college, the military, and missions
Connected to classmates, faculty, and staff
Ready to explore any career field they choose
Able to view life through the lens of Scripture
